text:
aisha: Heads-up — Galatea-7B (canary) showing repeating single-token echoes in mid-length prompts after ~60 tokens. Seen on 2 different rigs, reproduces in synth eval.
marco: can you paste a short example and the prompt?
aisha: Example:
User: "Summarize the policy on data retention."
Galatea: "The policy is to retain data for 90 days 90 days 90 days..."
Repro on 2/3 seeds.
lee_infra: deploy-bot shows canary at 3 nodes, traffic 5%. pausing rollouts until triage. @deploy-bot pause canary
deploy-bot: canary pause requested by lee_infra (id: canary-67) — actioned.
sarah_ml: Likely quantization spill or kv-cache misalignment. Which quant recipe did we use? q4_0 or q4_1?
marco: We used q4_0 with fused-attn. I'll test fp16 and q4_1. Also checking tokenizer mapping vs model hub tokenizer.
james_oncall: Logs show KV cache hits spike then drop at 58-62 tokens. snippet:
"ERROR: kvcache: unexpected cache reset at step 60"
aisha: Also noticed slightly different BPE merges vs upstream. Trying generate with original hub tokenizer now.
sarah_ml: Tokenizer mismatch + kv-cache reorder is a classic cause for suffix repetition. Any repro commands?
marco: Repro command I used:
```
python -m reproduce --model galatea-7b --prompt "Summarize the policy" --seed 42 --length 120
```
Reproduces reliably for me.
lee_infra: I'll spin a canary variant with fp16 kernels, q2 baseline, and disable continuous batching to rule out batch-induced seq misalignment.
deploy-bot: canary paused by lee_infra at 2305987720
sarah_ml: Actions & owners (ETA 4h): marco -> fp16 reproduce + tokenizer diff; aisha -> collect eval failure set; lee_infra -> canary config tests; james_oncall -> investigate kvcache logs.
marco: :thumbsup: starting now, will post results.
aisha: Early numbers: failure rate ~2.1% on our 1k eval set, spikes to ~9% on list-style prompts. dump at /mnt/galatea/echo_failures.log
james_oncall: Found regression in runtime patch — optimization merged last week changed attention key reorder when seq len > 64. PR #4123 touched kv cache layout. Rolling that back in canary.
lee_infra: Rolled back PR #4123 on canary nodes and restarted. Observing 10 minutes of traffic.
marco: After rollback, reproduction run: 0 repeats on 25/25 seeds. Looks like kv cache reorder bug. Opening postmortem + PR link.
aisha: Thanks — hold GA until we confirm across regions. Filing ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2379
sarah_ml: :white_check_mark: marking as blocking fix for next patch release.
